title: Anthropic prices Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at $8/1M input and $40/1M output tokens, down 20% from 5.1; fast mode costs $16/1M input and $80/1M output tokens (Frederic Lardinois/The New Stack)
summary: Frederic Lardinois / The New Stack: Anthropic prices Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at $8/1M input and $40/1M output tokens, down 20% from 5.1; fast mode costs $16/1M input and $80/1M output tokens — On Monday, Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the latest versions of its duo of flagship models.
